De AI zoekt zelf in je webshop en artike: The AI searches your webshop and articles itself and comes up with a proposal. You see that proposal before anything is written.
De kopie krijgt dezelfde inhoud, lijst e: The copy gets the same content, list and sender, and starts as a draft. No recipients or statistics are copied.
De lijst die vooraf gekozen staat als je: The list that is preselected when you link a form to the newsletter, and where sign-ups end up that do not specify a list. Leave empty if you want to choose each time.
De losse kliks per ontvanger. De totalen: The individual clicks per recipient. The totals per campaign are kept. Default: 365 days.
De nieuwsbrief instellingen zijn opgesla: The newsletter settings have been saved
De nieuwsbrief staat in het formulier: The newsletter is in the form
De regel die een mailbox naast het onder: The line a mailbox shows next to the subject.
De resterende 1 ontvanger krijgt hem nie: The remaining 1 recipient will no longer receive it. This cannot be undone.
De resterende :aantal ontvangers krijgen: The remaining :aantal recipients will no longer receive it. This cannot be undone.
De tekst die naast het vinkje staat, let: The text next to the checkbox, stored verbatim as proof. If you leave it empty, the consent itself is still recorded with time, IP and source, just without text.
Deze campagne heeft 1 ontvanger in de ve: This campaign has 1 recipient in the sending history. It will be deleted along with it. This cannot be undone.
Deze campagne heeft :aantal ontvangers i: This campaign has :aantal recipients in the sending history. They will be deleted along with it. This cannot be undone.
This campaign has no recipients yet. Are you sure you want to delete it?
Deze lijst heeft 1 contact. Die worden s: This list has 1 contact. It will be deleted along with the fields, the segments and the proof of consent. This cannot be undone.
Deze lijst heeft :aantal contacten. Die: This list has :aantal contacts. They will be deleted along with the fields, the segments and the proof of consent. This cannot be undone.
Deze lijst heeft geen contacten. Weet je: This list has no contacts. Are you sure you want to delete it?
Dit adres is geblokkeerd vanwege \":rede: This address is blocked because of ":reden". Last time the email bounced; deleting means you assume this address works again. The next newsletter will then be sent to it again.
Dit adres is geblokkeerd vanwege een spa: This address is blocked because of a spam complaint. Unlike an undeliverable address, this email did arrive: the recipient saw it and reported it as spam themselves. Deleting puts this address back on the list against their own will. The next newsletter will then be sent to it again.
Dit adres is met de hand geblokkeerd. Ve: This address was blocked by hand. Deleting lifts the block: the next newsletter will be sent to it again.
Dit adres kwam via een marktplaats zoals: This address came in via a marketplace such as Bol.com. That customer is a customer of the marketplace and has not given you consent, so they may not receive a newsletter. Only delete this line if you are sure this person also signed up themselves.
Dit contact was uitgeschreven. Leg vast: This contact was unsubscribed. Record why it may become active again, for example what the customer told you. The text is stored verbatim as new proof of consent.
Dit maakt de velden Voornaam en Achterna: This creates the fields First name and Last name. The email address is already on the contact itself and is not a separate field.
Dit veld heeft al ingevulde waarden. Het: This field already has values filled in. The type can no longer be changed, otherwise value_number and value_date stay on the old format and segmentation silently goes wrong.
Een campagne wordt in porties over de ti: A campaign is spread over time in batches. Leave empty to follow the site setting; 0 means no limit. Spreading protects your deliverability: thousands of emails at once from a domain that normally sends little is exactly the pattern spam filters look for.
Eerste vijftig contacten in dit segment: First fifty contacts in this segment
Haal eruit wat je niet wilt. Alleen wat: Remove what you do not want. Only what you leave in may appear in the email.
Het e-mailadres is hier niet te wijzigen: The email address cannot be changed here. The proof of consent (see below) belongs to this address; if you quietly change it here, that proof points to an address that no longer matches what is in the column.
The email address cannot be changed here. The proof of consent belongs to this address; if you quietly change it here, that proof points to an address that no longer matches what is in the column.
Je werkt nu in de kopie. Het origineel i: You are now working in the copy. The original is unchanged.
Klik op \"AI-voorstel bekijken\" om het: Click "View AI proposal" to review it and have the newsletter written.
Laat leeg om dat van de lijst te gebruik: Leave empty to use the one from the list.
Laat leeg om de instellingen van de site: Leave empty to keep the site settings. The header appears above every campaign of this list, the footer below it.
Laat leeg om het adres uit de algemene i: Leave empty to use the address from the general settings.
Laat leeg om het logo uit de e-mailinste: Leave empty to use the logo from the email settings.
Laat leeg om naar iedereen op de lijst t: Leave empty to send to everyone on the list.
Label: Label
Lees hem na voordat je hem verstuurt, en: Read it through before you send it, and save afterwards. Nothing has been saved yet.
Na een klik in de mail onthoudt de websi: After a click in the email the website remembers for thirty days who the visitor is, so popups can target a segment. This is tracking a visitor: mention it in the site's privacy statement before you turn it on. Only works with Measure clicks on.
Nobody has received this campaign yet.
Stuurt de links in de mail via deze webs: Routes the links in the email through this website, so you can see what is clicked. The recipient ends up on the same page.
Toont de mail met de echte veldwaarden v: Shows the email with the real field values of this contact. Empty shows the fallback values.
Wat als bewijs van toestemming bewaard w: What is stored as proof of consent, for example what the admin heard or saw the customer confirm. If you leave it empty, the consent itself is still recorded with timestamp and source, just without text.
Adds an invisible image to the email. Note: Apple Mail fetches it by default without anyone looking, so open rates are structurally too high.
Zet hier het afmeldblok als je de afmeld: Place the unsubscribe block here if you want to design the unsubscribe line yourself. If you do not, a default line is added automatically at the bottom: a newsletter may not be sent without an unsubscribe link.
